messages:
sam: quick heads-up — hitting a 404 in the KB when following the new onboarding checklist. page: /kb/runbooks/deploy.md -> image link to s3 returns 403/404 during staging check :frowning:
rachael: ugh, which image path? can you paste the broken url?
sam: sure — https://s3.internal.redwood/models/deploy/diag-v2.png  (404)
I ran a quick grep and it looks like the file was renamed in the assets bucket last week.
I can open a tiny PR to rehost and update the markdown if nobody owns this page.
docs-bot: automated-scan: KB asset 404 detected: /kb/runbooks/deploy.md (severity: low) — created issue #KB-472
liam: I can pick this up in the next 30m. quick Q: do we prefer rehosting under the docs CDN or point to a new s3 path?
sam: prefer CDN for stability. sed that worked locally: 
```bash
# replace old path with cdn-hosted path
sed -i 's|https://s3.internal.redwood/models/deploy/diag-v2.png|https://cdn.redwood-internal/assets/diags/diag-v2.png|g' kb/runbooks/deploy.md
```
(simple, one-line fix)
rachael: pinging @docs-team and @infra — infra, did we move anything related to that bucket last week? :eyes:
docs-bot: infra-deploy-log: bucket migration completed 2025-11-18 by infra-service-account
alisha: we did a cleanup job and renamed a few folders, forgot to add redirects. my bad — will add a redirect but go ahead and rehost to CDN in the short term.
liam: awesome. I'll open a small PR with the sed change + rehosted image; assign to @rachael for a quick review. will include the before/after screenshot in PR description.
sam: thanks liam. small ask for reviewers — mark as "cherry-pick to staging" so we can smoke test before tomorrow's onboarding demo.
rachael: noted, I'll review within the hour. :thumbsup:
alisha: will follow up on the redirect ticket so we don't regress. adding myself to the KB issue.
sam: great — leaving the thread here. tagging for visibility: @oncall and @dev-experience. :white_check_mark:
